test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Gulshan drove his car for 77 km towards north, then he turned left and drove for 109 km. Again, he turned left and drove yet another 77 km. Again, he turned left, drove his car 127 km and stopped. What is the shortest distance between the starting point and the stopping point?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
**Given: **All turns are 90 degree turns only.

Gulshan drove his car for 77 km towards north

Then he turned left and drove for 109 km.

Again, he turned left and drove yet another 77 km.

Again, he turned left, drove his car 127 km and stopped. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be764fea803708f973ee610f11cb29491b796bbf741a751d95274e35aac3844a.png] 

 

Thus, the shortest distance between the starting point and the end point is (127 km - 109 km) = 18 km.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
